cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile for her clients; that's why they love her.
cards.exUz: U har doim mijozlari uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi; shuning uchun ular uni yaxshi ko'rishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bajarish kerak bo'lganidan ko'proq harakat qilish, alohida urinish ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: He really puts his heart into his music; you can feel the passion.
cards.exUz: U o'z musiqasiga jonini beradi; siz uning ishtiyoqini his qilishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir juda ko'p mehnat va g'ayrat sarflash, butun vujudi bilan kirishish.

cards.ex: We should always strive for excellence in everything we do.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim qilgan har bir ishimizda mukammallikka intilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir erishish uchun qattiq harakat qilish, intilish, urinish.

cards.ex: She has a burning desire to become a doctor and help people.
cards.exUz: Uning shifokor bo'lib, odamlarga yordam berishga qattiq istagi bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va qat'iy istak, orzu-havas.

cards.ex: He's determined to climb the ladder in the company and become CEO.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyada martaba zinasidan ko'tarilib, bosh direktor bo'lishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ishda yoki hayotda yuqori lavozimlarga erishish, muvaffaqiyatga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: She's driven to succeed and won't let anything stand in her way.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatga intiladi va hech narsaga yo'lida to'sqinlik qilishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishishga kuchli motivatsiyaga ega bo'lish, maqsad sari harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her tenacity and grit helped her overcome many obstacles.
cards.exUz: Uning qaysarligi va matonati unga ko'plab to'siqlarni yengishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, maqsadga erishish uchun qat'iyatlilik va jur'at.

cards.ex: It's important to aim high, even if you don't always reach your goals.
cards.exUz: Garchi har doim maqsadlaringizga erisha olmasangiz ham, yuqori maqsadlarni qo'yish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Katta va muhim maqsadlarni qo'yish, yuqori natijalarga intilish.

cards.ex: You have to put in the work if you want to see results.
cards.exUz: Agar natijalarni ko'rmoqchi bo'lsangiz, mehnat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun zarur bo'lgan mehnatni qilish, harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's set her sights on getting a scholarship to a top university.
cards.exUz: U eng yaxshi universitetga stipendiya olishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq intilayotgan maqsadni belgilash, nimagadir erishishni rejalashtirish.

cards.ex: She's a real go-getter; she always gets the job done.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy intiluvchan; u har doim ishni bajaradi.
cards.uzDef: Faol, maqsadga yo'naltirilgan, muvaffaqiyatga erishishga intiladigan odam.

cards.ex: With a can-do attitude, you can overcome any challenge.
cards.exUz: Qila olaman munosabati bilan har qanday qiyinchilikni engishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday vazifani bajarishga ishonch va qobiliyatga ega bo'lish, ijobiy fikrlash.

cards.ex: Our project manager is really on the ball; she never misses a deadline.
cards.exUz: Bizning loyiha menejerimiz juda hushyor; u hech qachon muddatni o'tkazib yubormaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tezkor, hushyor, diqqatli, vaziyatni nazorat qila oladigan.

cards.ex: He really rose to the occasion and delivered a fantastic presentation.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham vaziyatga moslashdi va ajoyib taqdimot qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan qiyinchilikka yoki imkoniyatga muvaffaqiyatli javob berish, a'lo darajada harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Just give it your all, and you'll have no regrets.
cards.exUz: Faqat borini bering, shunda afsuslanmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Qo'lingizdan kelganicha harakat qilish, maksimal darajada urinish.

cards.ex: They told us to reach for the stars and never give up on our dreams.
cards.exUz: Ular bizga yulduzlarga intilishni va orzularimizdan voz kechmaslikni aytishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta maqsadlarga intilish, cheksiz orzular qilish.

cards.ex: Starting a new job can be a steep learning curve, but it's also exciting.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishni boshlash qiyin o'rganish bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u hayajonli hamdir.
cards.uzDef: Tez va ko'p narsani o'rganish kerak bo'lgan qiyin vaziyat.

cards.ex: It's not easy, but hard work pays off in the end.
cards.exUz: Oson emas, lekin oxir-oqibatda qattiq mehnat o'z samarasini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq mehnat oxir-oqibatda muvaffaqiyatga olib keladi.

cards.ex: It's hard to stay focused when there are so many distractions.
cards.exUz: Chalg'itadigan narsalar juda ko'p bo'lganda, diqqatni jamlash qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir nuqtaga jamlash, maqsadga e'tibor qaratish.

cards.ex: Remember, perseverance is key to success.
cards.exUz: Esda tuting, qaysarlik muvaffaqiyat kalitidir.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, davom etish zarur.

cards.ex: She has the drive to succeed, and I know she'll go far.
cards.exUz: Unda muvaffaqiyatga erishish istagi bor va men bilaman, u uzoqqa boradi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun kuchli ichki motivatsiya.

cards.ex: He had to overcome many obstacles to achieve his goals.
cards.exUz: U o'z maqsadlariga erishish uchun ko'plab to'siqlarni yengishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lda paydo bo'ladigan qiyinchiliklarni muvaffaqiyatli bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: You need to push yourself if you want to improve.
cards.exUz: Agar yaxshilanmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni majburlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni qiyinroq ishlashga yoki yaxshiroq bo'lishga undash.

cards.ex: I had to work my tail off to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Loyiha o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun juda qattiq mehnat qilishimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq mehnat qilish, bor kuchingizni sarflash.

cards.ex: That's the spirit! Never say die!
cards.exUz: Bu ruh! Hech qachon taslim bo'lmang!
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon taslim bo'lmaslik, umidni yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: He's hungry for success and willing to do whatever it takes.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatga chanqoq va buning uchun hamma narsaga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishishga juda intilish, kuchli xohishga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's tough, but you need to stay the course and finish what you started.
cards.exUz: Qiyin, lekin siz yo'lda qolishingiz va boshlagan ishingizni tugatishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan yo'lda davom etish, maqsaddan chetga chiqmaslik.

cards.ex: We want to help our students reach their full potential.
cards.exUz: Biz o'quvchilarimizga o'zlarining to'liq imkoniyatlariga erishishga yordam bermoqchimiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizning barcha qobiliyatlaringizni to'liq ishga solish, maksimal darajaga erishish.

cards.ex: He aspired to greatness and dedicated his life to science.
cards.exUz: U buyuklikka intildi va hayotini fanga bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va muhim narsalarga erishishga intilish, buyuk bo'lishni xohlash.

cards.ex: She had a burning ambition to become a famous writer.
cards.exUz: U mashhur yozuvchi bo'lishga qattiq ambitsiyaga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va qizg'in ambitsiya, katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish istagi.
